Before I do anything with this — "sort out how we're doing retros" could mean a few different things, and I want to make sure I'm solving the actual problem, not just the first one I guess at. Also, worth being upfront: I don't have a way to actually run a retro yet — no tool wired for it. So even once we know what's wrong, I can talk it through with you here, not execute a fix.

What specifically feels like it needs work? A few possibilities:

- The format itself (same three questions every time, going stale)
- Turnout / participation (people not showing up or not engaging)
- The output (retros happen but nothing changes afterward)
- Something specific that happened in the last one

Do you have a concrete thing in mind, or is this more of a general "something's off" feeling? If it's the latter, I'd rather say that plainly than manufacture a diagnosis — I haven't seen enough yet to have a confident read on what's actually broken.
